THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. 3/2/5/5/2024.
I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Lot No. 01 - 07 (Lots 07) allotments in total extent of about 0.0406 Hectare of land in Preliminary Plan No. Gam. 1994 and prepared by the Surveyor-Superintendent on behalf of Surveyor - Gampaha General situated in the village of Weligampitiya, Minor Division of Ragam Pattuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ragam Pattuwa in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Ja Ela in Gampaha District in the Western Province.
01. Lot No. 01 Name of land: Suduwelikurudu Watta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: U. Fonseka, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0124 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 02 Name of land: Suduwelikurudu Watta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Lesly Rodrigo, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0038 Hectare.

03. Lot No. 03 Name of land: Kuruduwatta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation and Contains part of a Statue; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: W. S. J. Silva, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0076 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 04 Name of land: Kuruduwatta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. D. R. Wijesurendra, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0060 Hectare.
05. Lot No. 05 Name of land: Kuruduwatta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: M. A. Silva, No. 819/A, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0008 Hectare.
06. Lot No. 06 Name of land: Wellakurudugaha Watta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: D. D. Dabare, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0080 Hectare.
07. Lot No. 07 Name of land: Wellakurudugaha Watta; Description: Garden, Not Cultivation; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: S. G. Rangoda, Thumpeliya, Ja Ela; Extent: 0.0020 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat office of Ja Ela on 31st day of December 2015, at 10.00

LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS
AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT. No. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. RPDS/LND/09/ACQ/05/05/06.

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following lands which are required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be acquired:

Following allotments of land depicted as Lot No. 139, 140, 141, 142, 143 in extent 0.0230 Hectare in Final Village Plan No. 82 of supplementary No. 09 of Plan No. 12 situated in Ethoya Village of Ethoya Grama Niladari Division of Divisional Secretary’s Division Rathnapura in the District of Rathnapura in Sabaragamuwa Province.

01. Lot No. 139 Name of land: Ethoya Gammeddegoda Wathuyaya alias Gamagewaththa; Detail: Home Garden, There is coconut tree about 10-15 years old; Claimant: K. A. L. Weerasuriya, Ethoya, Rathnapura; Extent: 0.0015 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 140 Name of land: —; Detail: Road; Extent: 0.0199 Hectare.
03. Lot No. 141 Name of land: Ethoya Gammeddegoda Wathuyaya alias Pussellewaththa; Detail: Home Garden; Claimant: P. A. U. Upasena, Pussellegedara, Ethoya, Rathnapura; Extent: 0.0011 Hectare.
04. Lot No. 142 Name of land: Ethoya Gammeddegoda Wathuyaya alias Pussellewaththa; Detail: Home Garden; Claimant: P. A. Malani, Pussellegedara, Ethoya, Rathnapura; Extent: 0.0001 Hectare.

05. Lot No. 143 Name of land: Ethoya Gammeddegoda Wathuyaya alias Pussellewaththa; Detail: Home Garden, There are three Mahogani trees and a Jak tree about 05-10 years old; Claimant: P. A. Malani, Pussellegedara, Ethoya, Rathnapura; Extent: 0.0004 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid lands on which servitude is to be acquired are hereby requested to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at 10.00 a.m 30th December, 2015 at Rathnapura Divisional Secretariat.

Moreover, they are here by requested to notify to me in writing with two duplicates on or before the 23rd day of December 2015 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said lands, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount. C. M. KOTTAWATHTHA, Divisional Secretary, Rathnapura.
Divisional Secretariat, Rathnapura. 16th November, 2015. 12 - 111

I hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land which required for a public purpose:
Description of the Land to be acquired:

The land containing in extent 0.0009 hectare, shown as Lot No. 01 Surveyor General’s Preliminary Plan No. Ma/1654, situated at Kaludewala Ward No. 2 - Mandandawala (Within Municipal Council limit of Matale) Villages, in Medasiya Pattuwa Minor Division, Matale Divisional Secretary’s Division, Matale District, Central Province.
